integrity: The universal proof uses integral equivariant Mayer–Vietoris and join orientation; the finite checker is corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: The integral representation theorem is conditional on existence of a finite affine plane of order q≥3, covers no equivariant wedge splitting, and is not an integral quotient-homology formula. The translation specialization assumes a Desarguesian plane of prime-power order. Possible unindexed equivalents and one abstract-only relevant source remain.
title: Integral collineation modules of affine-plane Vietoris–Rips homology
